pages.text: Three sheets of paper and some paints were on the table. Pongi sat in the middle seat.
"Today I'm going to draw the canal." Pongi picked up a blue colored pencil.
Dad sat down beside her. "I'm pretty good at drawing, you know."
Pongi drew a long canal. She put a boat on it too.
Dad's paper was covered in circles. "This is just the beginning."
Pongi's little brother dipped a finger in paint and pressed it onto the paper.
Press, press, press. A row of marks appeared.
Pongi looked at her little brother's paper. "Those are duck footprints!"
Mom put two pictures on the wall. Dad quietly turned his own paper over.
Pongi stepped back to look. A line of duck footprints went along the canal.
